name: Outdoor Stackable Dining Chair
material: 2*1 teslin fabrics, steel frame w/t powder coated
description: This sling chair has a streamlined look with a powder coated steel frame and a comfortable textilene fabric material that is breathable. Create a comfortable seating arrangement with multiple chairs that are stackable up to four, for long or short-term storage. For longevity, care should be taken to protect from long periods of wet weather.
